_comment: Track evolution (POLISH card). A grid of cellM cells over the racing surface. rubber: every wheel lays layPerSec x load share x (0.5 + slip) where it runs; full rubber = +gripBonus grip. marbles: tyre wear x shedPerWear lands throwM to the outside of a corner (scaled by how hard it corners); full marbles = -gripLoss grip; each wheel running over them sweeps sweepPerSec. sessions.rubberLoss: share of rubber gone between sessions of a weekend (marbles are swept to zero). start: a new weekend's rubber along the racing line for Medium / Rubbered, over lineWidthM. enabled: false = fixed grip, as before this card. visual (client only): rubber drawn as rubberRgb up to rubberMaxAlpha; marbles as marbleRgb pebbles, up to marbleDots per cell.
